notes.en: UNTESTED inactive draft. Central code-policy review and explicit paid execution authorization must precede enabling both config flags and the runtime gate. Single non-cancelling workflow concurrency is required across the hub. The immutable check ledger must remain readable and retained; missing or truncated state blocks work. Full fetch downloads all history and blobs reachable from both SHAs: no shallow/partial clone, no hard aggregate disk or wire-byte ceiling. The observed disk limit can overshoot between polls; use a runner disk quota for a hard ceiling. Target check output contains bounded untrusted finding previews; human resolution, independence and merge gates still apply.
notes.ja: 未テスト・無効状態の草案。中央のコード・方針レビューと明示的な有料実行承認を経てから、configの両フラグと実行時ゲートを有効化する。hub全体で単一・非キャンセルの同時実行制御が必要。固定check台帳を保持し、欠落・打切り時は停止。full fetchは両SHAから到達可能な全履歴・blobを取得し、総ディスク・通信量の厳密上限はない。監視間隔中の超過はあり得るため厳密制限にはrunner側quotaが必要。対象check内の指摘抜粋は未信頼。指摘解消・独立性・人のmerge gateは継続。
